## Local patches

Applied at CMake configure time onto a copy of `UxPlay/lib` (`cmake/PatchUxPlay.cmake`); the submodule stays pristine.

- `0001-fix-hls-playlist-crash.patch` — fix hls playlist crash (`lib/airplay_video.c, lib/http_handlers.h`)
- `0002-fix-uaf-on-playlist-refresh.patch` — fix uaf on playlist refresh (`lib/airplay_video.c, lib/http_handlers.h`)
- `0003-refresh-live-media-playlists-on-demand.patch` — refresh live media playlists on demand (`lib/airplay_video.c, lib/airplay_video.h, lib/http_handlers.h`)
- `0004-video-sender-compat.patch` — video sender compat (`lib/http_handlers.h, lib/raop_handlers.h`)
- `0005-signal-video-reset-on-abandoned-play-connection.patch` — signal video reset on abandoned play connection (`lib/http_handlers.h, lib/raop.c, lib/raop.h`)
- `0006-deliver-volume-while-audio-stream-paused.patch` — deliver volume while audio stream paused (`lib/raop_handlers.h`)

OpenSSL itself (`OPENSSL_BUILD_VERSION` in `CMakeLists.txt`): 3.4.4
